# Metric rules version 4 on the 500 sampled coins

<!-- Generated by ingest/scripts/a6/compare-v4.ts from the stored candles of the sample (offline: no database written, no provider called). Version 3 values are the ones stored in the dumps. -->

Each coin is recomputed with the real library at the rules of docs/metrics.md version 4 and compared with the version 3 values stored for it. A screened-out coin is stored by the metrics stage with the screen's own result, so it is compared with that. "Listed" means an ATH of $100,000 or more at version 4. Market caps are in USD.

## Counts

- Coins compared: 500
- Coins whose ATH changes: 14
- Of those, dropping under $100,000: 10
- Coins losing the rug pattern: 3; gaining it: 0
- Coins whose ATH did not change but whose drawdown moves: 0, rug pattern: 0, seconds above $100,000: 0

## Notes

- The 14 coins, their ATH before and after, the 10 that drop under $100,000, the 3 that lose the rug pattern, and the absence of any other move match the figures expected from the prototype. The ATH of every coin also matches the prototype's funded-window result.
- The stored version 3 wick is more than three times the stored ATH on 28 coins; the prototype counted 27. The difference was not investigated further and nothing was tuned.
- The 35 screened-out coins of the sample are stored at version 3 with a daily-high wick. At version 4 they have no wick (daily bars no longer feed it); the daily bars stay stored. The wick table leaves them out.
- Under version 4 the wick is a traded minute's open or close, so the table's "new wick" is a figure the pool printed on real volume; where it equals the ATH, the ATH's own window is the best candidate.
